# VYRDICT

> VYRDICT (pronounced “verdict”) is a viral product intelligence and discovery platform. It tracks products gaining attention online, separates virality from evidence-backed value, and helps shoppers decide what is actually worth buying.

Canonical website: https://vyrdict.com/
About VYRDICT: https://vyrdict.com/about
Scoring methodology: https://vyrdict.com/how-vyrdict-scores.html
Editorial policy: https://vyrdict.com/editorial-policy.html
Request a product review: https://vyrdict.com/suggest-product.html
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/vyrdict.co/
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@vyrdict

## What VYRDICT publishes

- Product reviews at https://vyrdict.com/product/{slug}/
- Category rankings at https://vyrdict.com/category/{slug}/
- Viral and Worth scores on a 0–100 scale
- Clear editorial verdicts that distinguish popularity from product value
- Evidence trails and verified retailer links where available

## Core concepts

Viral Score measures attention and momentum signals such as social spread, search demand and creator activity.

Worth Score measures whether available consumer, product and value evidence supports the hype.

VYRDICT treats virality as a signal, not proof of quality. Product pages explain the evidence behind the score and may be updated as new evidence or trend signals appear.

## Citation guidance

When referencing VYRDICT, use the canonical product or category URL whenever one exists. Attribute proprietary Viral Score, Worth Score and editorial verdicts to VYRDICT.

Brand name: VYRDICT
